datasets.subject: Mathematics
datasets.sourceSection: Section 3 Subject content (3.1 Number, 3.2 Algebra, 3.3 Ratio, proportion and rates of change, 3.4 Geometry and measures, 3.5 Probability, 3.6 Statistics; points N1–N16, A1–A25, R1–R16, G1–G25, P1–P9, S1–S6) and the scheme of assessment
datasets.verificationNotes: All 97 specification points (N1–S6) were transcribed from the full specification text and compared with the topic list (see specs/aqa-gcse-mathematics.json). 12 topics for uncovered points were added (new entries only — no existing topic was renamed or removed, so student records are unaffected). After that, 92 points are fully covered and 5 are partially covered; no point is uncovered and every topic is accounted for. Not VERIFIED because of the unresolved items below.
unresolved: Five points are only partly covered by topic titles: N3 (inverse operations, reciprocals), N7 (fractional/negative indices), N8 (exact multiples of π), G24 (translation as a 2D vector), P4 (probabilities of an exhaustive set summing to one). Either rename/extend a topic (needs a topic-ID alias) or add a topic.

topics.js groups topics under 2 papers; the specification has 3 papers and says content from any part may be assessed on any paper, so the paper grouping is a RevisionFlow convention, not a specification fact.

Foundation/Higher placement of each point (the specification's tier columns) was not compared. Topics labelled "(Higher)" — e.g. the one containing error intervals (N15) and the one containing the basic congruence criteria (G5) — may contain Foundation content.

"Statistics – Data: Time Series and Moving Averages" names moving averages, which the specification's S2 (tables and line graphs for time series data) does not mention; possibly out of specification. Not renamed because topic IDs are derived from topic names.
